maddeler.e:
احتضرتما (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَرْتُمَا (iḥtaḍartumā) /iħ.ta.dˤar.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# اُحْتُضِرْتُمَا (uḥtuḍirtumā) /uħ.tu.dˤir.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
